title: Annual geomagnetic history: monthly mean planetary Ap index
upstream: GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences, Adolf Schmidt Observatory, Niemegk
publication: Matzka, J., Bronkalla, O., Tornow, K., Elger, K., Stolle, C. (2021). Geomagnetic Kp index. GFZ Data Services. doi:10.5880/Kp.0001
secondary_compilation: Jan Alvestad, Solar Terrestrial Activity Report, monthly Average ap data based on GFZ Potsdam WDC, viewed 2026-11-08
license: GFZ geomagnetic indices CC BY 4.0; attribute GFZ and Matzka et al. (2021)
metric: Mean of planetary daily Ap over each complete UTC calendar month, as reported by secondary source. Not Kp and not auroral-oval measurements.
quality_notes: Values transcribed from published monthly table. October 2026 reported with one decimal place; latest values may be preliminary/quicklook or revised. September 2026 shown as 7.54.
animation_method: A single image frame per monthly value, each displayed 520 ms. Polar geography rendered from a North-pole orthographic map. Decorative halo brightness, thickness, and amplitude respond monotonically to Ap; not a reconstruction of aurora position or emissions. No synthetic intermediate data samples.
